q: 1. Which approach is typically adopted by states to manage population growth in urban areas under planned development?
options: Building affordable housing and improving infrastructure
Ignoring the need for urban development
explain: States manage urban growth by proactively planning for affordable housing and infrastructure to prevent the rise of slums and chaotic sprawl.

q: 2. According to the Recent study conducted by department of hydrology and metrology, the average maximum temperature of Nepal has risen by ----------
explain: Studies by the Department of Hydrology and Meteorology (DHM) indicate an annual increase in maximum temperature of about 0.056°C in Nepal.

q: 3. Which of the following Greenhouse Gases has the highest atmospheric lifetime?
explain: Sulphur Hexafluoride (SF6) is extremely stable and can remain in the atmosphere for over 3,000 years.

q: 4. When was Kalapathar meeting at foothill of Mt. Everest held to draw the attention of the world regarding the effect of Climate Change?
explain: The Nepal Cabinet held a historic meeting at Kalapathar (5,542m) on December 4, 2009 (Mangsir 19, 2066).

q: 5. Which is the nation to conduct the Cabinet Meeting under the water to gain the attention of the world to reduce the effect of climate change?
explain: The Maldives held an underwater cabinet meeting in 2009 to highlight the threat of rising sea levels to the island nation.

q: 6. Which international organization has declared a global climate & environmental emergency?
explain: The European Parliament declared a 'climate and environmental emergency' in Europe and globally in November 2019.

q: 7. When was the National Climate Change Policy introduced in Nepal?
explain: The revised National Climate Change Policy was approved in 2076 B.S. (2019), replacing the previous 2067 policy.
